newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldova raises discount rate to 21 pct from 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Moldova raises discount rate to 21 pct from 20 pct.

text.p: Moldova's National Bank said on Thursday it had raised its official annual discount rate to 21 percent from 20 percent effective since September 25.
The new rate was set at a credit funds auction, as 13 banks acquired a total of 9.07 million lei ($1.96 million) of National Bank reserves, it said in a statement.

Trailing low inflation, official discount rates have been falling steadily from a high of 377 percent in February 1994. The National Bank has eliminated soft loans to the economy and sells up to 90 percent of its credit funds at regular auctions.
Prices in the first nine months of the year grew by 10.8 percent. Officials expect annual inflation to fall to 15-17 percent this year from 23.8 percent in 1995.
